Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL236. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, target type SINGLE PROTEIN, organism tax ID 9606, standard type IC50, exact relation, and non-null pChEMBL value. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
